تستأمنون (form X)
# تَسْتَأْمِنُونَ (tastaʔminūna) /tas.taʔ.mi.nuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأْمَنَ (istaʔmana)
# تُسْتَأْمَنُونَ (tustaʔmanūna) /tus.taʔ.ma.nuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَأْمَنَ (istaʔmana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
